title: Eval workflow gate doesn't consume scoreboard
wanted_capability: `nightly-eval-arc` (and similar eval arcs) should be able to route on actual scoreboard drift — blocked on the same `op: shell` stdout capture primitive (gap tooling/workflow-engine/op-shell-stdout-capture).
notes: Same shape as the `op: shell` engine gap above. nightly-eval-arc records that the harness ran; can't route on actual drift.
resolution_note: Unblocked and wired (verified 2026-07-14 on beta/blackbox-v2): the blocking primitive (op: shell stdout capture, gap-c5518519) is implemented, and nightly-eval-arc (system-defaults/agentic-corpus/workflows/nightly-eval-arc.json) routes on actual scoreboard drift: RunSuite captures the suite run via the shell op's {exit_code, stdout, stderr, parsed} into_var, Score computes drift_pp via score_eval_output (src/workflow/ops/eval_score.rs), and Decide branches stable / drift_minor / drift_major through the domain:eval/drift-policy gate packet.
